purpose: Reviewed allowlist for every tests/test-*.ps1 script. Included, skipped, and unavailable dispositions are explicit per CI engine.

tests.prerequisites: Windows and PowerShell 5.1 or later; writable temporary directory.
tests.boundary: Synthetic payload bytes with fake download, signature, and process callbacks. The test copy omits the ACL write; no network request or executable launch.

tests.prerequisites: Native Linux or macOS host; PowerShell Core 7.6.9; writable temporary directory; chmod utility.
tests.boundary: Uses temporary fake package-manager and pwsh commands with captured argv; install.sh runs from a path with spaces and the WhatIf branch is AST-isolated. It does not call a live provider or mutate host state.

Desktop-5.1.reason: Native CLI boundary checks require a Linux or macOS PowerShell Core runner.

Core-7.6.9.reason: The Windows Core matrix skips this test; native Linux and macOS jobs run it directly.

Core-7.6.9.reason: The standard windows-2025 CI host is Windows Server 2025, outside the Windows 11 client runtime contract.
